overloadMerges.note: The mechanical role guess grabbed the leading 'Compatibility Note' sentence instead of the actual behavior sentence; replaced with an accurate semanticRole. Also corrected users' direction: the parameter table arrow is '↔' (inout) -- the doc says the BLOB must already contain users going in some contexts but is documented as an out-parameter the command fills with the encrypted account/group list, so direction is 'out', not the mechanical 'in' default.

params.name: users
params.description: Receives the encrypted list of all user accounts and database groups

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Stores in the BLOB users the encrypted list of all user accounts and database groups created by the Administrator, readable only via BLOB TO USERS.

constraints: Only works in binary databases; in 4D projects it always returns an empty BLOB.
Only the database Administrator or Designer can execute this command; otherwise it does nothing and generates privilege error -9949.
The generated BLOB is encrypted and can only be read back with BLOB TO USERS.
